originality.rationale: Gong et al. supply the motivating two-charger collision and Bell-like cases, but accessible source discussion does not assert the complete collective-dipole classification or the non-Bell coherent product witness. An earlier distinct fixed-point characterization only covers chargers that keep a completely excited battery excited, and does not imply this all-phases condition or half-filling trajectory. Quach–Munro use reservoir dark states; Li et al. study master-equation coherent-ancilla phases. Residual unseen full-text priority risks are retained; best-knowledge originality is not independent certification.

value.rationale: The theorem fills the physically natural exact-classification gap for phase-blind charger preparations and identifies collective transverse polarization as the measurable cancellation invariant. Its non-Bell coherent separable product supplies a concrete nontrivial half-filled charging trajectory under adaptive local readout, not just a vacuous dark or already fully charged state. It precisely distinguishes conditional mean-energy uniformity from intrinsic quantum measurement variance.
